description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Cecil (Paladin) (Holy)] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (2.00 or 6.70 each), grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [Holy +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2] and  [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (2.00 or 6.70 each), grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [Holy +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2] and  [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Cecil (Paladin) (Holy)
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
